description_en: Queries the rule-level compliance statistics in a specified compliance package
description_zh: 查询指定合规包中规则维度合规统计
name: GetConfigRuleComplianceByPack

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package ID.

For information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

ConfigRuleComplianceResult.description_en: The compliance results of rules in the compliance package
ConfigRuleComplianceResult.description_zh: 合规包中规则的合规结果

CompliantCount.description_en: The total number of rules whose evaluation results are all compliant when the rules in the compliance package evaluate resources
CompliantCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果全部为合规的规则总数

ConfigRuleCompliances.description_en: The list of rules and their compliance results in the compliance package
ConfigRuleCompliances.description_zh: 合规包中的规则及合规结果列表

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance evaluation result of the rule. Valid values:
COMPLIANT: Compliant.
NON_COMPLIANT: Non-compliant.
NOT_APPLICABLE: Not applicable.
INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Insufficient data
ComplianceType.description_zh:
规则合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据

ConfigRuleId.description_en: The ID of the rule in the compliance package

ConfigRuleName.description_en: The name of the rule in the compliance package
ConfigRuleName.example: The bandwidth of the Elastic IP instance meets the minimum requirements.

IgnoredCount.description_en: The total number of rules whose evaluation results contain "Ignored" when the rules in the compliance package evaluate resources
IgnoredCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果包含“已忽略”的规则总数

InsufficientDataCount.description_en: The total number of rules whose evaluation results contain "Insufficient Data" when the rules in the compliance package evaluate resources
InsufficientDataCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果包含“无数据”的规则总数

NonCompliantCount.description_en: The number of non-compliant compliance rules

NotApplicableCount.description_en: The total number of rules whose evaluation results contain "Not Applicable" when the rules in the compliance package evaluate resources
NotApplicableCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果包含“不适用”的规则总数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of rules in the compliance package
